title: Race Condition Between Maglev IdentityMap and Mark-Compact GC ThinString Shortcutting Leads to OOB Write in Trusted Space
description_snippet:
## DETAILS

Although this is a Maglev vulnerability, it is not an optimization logic bug. Instead, it is a race condition between `IdentityMap` and GC in Maglev.

Below are the details.
